# Story 33 — FE-03 Ticket List and Ticket Detail Workspace (Story: 480)

## Prerequisites

- Story 31 (`478` — frontend shell/foundation) completed: the app shell, router, auth provider, permission guards and API client layer already exist under `frontend/src/shell/`, `frontend/src/auth/` and `frontend/src/api/`.
- Story 32 (`479`) completed where it introduces shared list/table and form primitives; if a shared data-table primitive exists, reuse it instead of writing a new one — grep `frontend/src/shell/` for an existing table/list component before creating one.
- The backend ticketing surface is frozen: `docs/api/openapi.v1.frozen.yaml` and `tests/Feature/Api/ContractFreezeTest.php`. **Do not** propose backend contract changes in this story; if a needed field is missing, record it in the story notes and use what the API already returns.
- Generated API client is produced by orval (`frontend/orval.config.ts`) into `frontend/src/api/generated/`. **Do not hand-edit generated files.**

---

## Story Goal

Deliver the agent workspace: a fast, filterable ticket list and a single-screen ticket detail view.

1. **Ticket list** with server-driven filters, sort, pagination, saved views and bulk actions on selected rows.
2. **Ticket detail** on one screen: conversation thread, ticket properties, customer context, SLA position, and history/audit — no second navigation to see any of these.
3. **Reply vs. internal note** are visually unmistakable; an internal note can never be sent as a public reply by accident.
4. **Only server-reported available transitions** are offered in the status control.
5. **Assignment conflicts and stale edits** (HTTP 409 / version conflict) surface a clear conflict banner with a recovery path (reload latest, retry).
6. **SLA figures are rendered verbatim from the API** — no elapsed/remaining recomputation in the browser beyond formatting a server-provided timestamp/label.
7. **Attachment upload** shows upload progress, the scanning state, and rejection reasons.

**Not in scope:** knowledge-base panel, AI suggestion panel, chat/messaging channel consoles, reporting screens, portal screens. Those belong to their own frontend stories (`481`–`484`).

## Product rules (from story)

| Behaviour | Rule |
|---|---|
| Composer visibility | Public reply and internal note are **separate, visually distinct modes**. Internal note mode uses a distinct background/border and a persistent "internal — not visible to the customer" label. Switching modes clears no text but re-confirms the target. Submitting requires the visibility value from `postTicketMessagesBodyVisibility.ts`; there is no default that silently sends internal content publicly. |
| Status control | The status menu is built **only** from the available-transitions list in the detail payload. If the list is empty, the control is disabled with an explanatory hint. Never render the full status catalogue as if all of it were reachable. |
| SLA | Render server-provided SLA fields (target, position/state, breach flag, timestamps) as-is. Formatting a timestamp for display is allowed; computing remaining time, percentages or breach state in the browser is **forbidden**. |
| Concurrency | Any 409 from a ticket mutation renders a conflict banner with the server message plus a **Reload latest** action that refetches the detail query and re-enables the form. Never fail silently, never auto-overwrite. |
| Attachments | Upload shows a determinate progress bar, then the scan state from the attachment payload, and on rejection the server's error message/code (too large / infected / pending). |
| Permissions | Every mutating control is gated by an `ActionGuard` on a permission key from `PermissionKey.php`. Hidden ≠ disabled: follow whatever convention Story 31/32 established in `ActionGuard.tsx`. |

### 6 — Composer: reply vs internal note (critical)

**File: `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/TicketComposer.tsx`**

```ts
import type { PostTicketMessagesBodyVisibility } from '@/api/generated/model/postTicketMessagesBodyVisibility';
// exact import path/name: confirm against frontend/src/api/generated/model/index.ts
```

- Mode is an explicit two-way segmented control bound to the generated visibility union. **There is no implicit default that sends publicly** — if the mode is not set, the submit button is disabled.
- Internal mode: distinct panel background/border, a persistent badge with the localized string `tickets.composer.internalWarning` ("Internal note — the customer will not see this"), and a differently-labelled submit button.
- Public mode: shows the recipient (customer contact) so the agent sees who receives it.
- Submitting sends the visibility value from the generated model. Never send a hardcoded string literal.
- Send an idempotency key header on message creation if the mutator does not already inject one — check `frontend/src/api/http/mutator.ts` and `app/Http/Middleware/EnforceIdempotency.php`, and mirror what `tests/Feature/Ticketing/TicketMessageIdempotencyTest.php` expects.
- On failure, keep the draft text in state; never clear the composer on error.
- Retry for failed messages uses the retry endpoint (grep `routes/api.php` for `retry`; backend action is `app/Domains/Ticketing/Actions/RetryTicketMessage.php`). Only offer retry when the message's delivery state permits it, per `app/Domains/Ticketing/Services/Conversation/DeliveryStateMachine.php`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Bulk endpoints may not exist.** The repository tree shows no `BulkTicket*` controller or action under `app/Domains/Ticketing/`. Before implementing task 3's fan-out, grep `routes/api.php` for `bulk`. If a bulk route exists, use it and delete the fan-out plan; if not, the sequenced fan-out with per-item error reporting is the implementation. **Record which branch you took in the PR description.**
- **Saved-view endpoints unverified.** `TicketSavedView.php`, `SaveTicketView.php`, `DeleteTicketView.php` and `TicketSavedViewResource.php` exist, but the routes were not read. Grep `routes/api.php` for `views` before building `SavedViewsBar.tsx`. If no route is exposed, ship saved views as **local-storage-backed** with a clear TODO comment referencing this story, and note it in Done Criteria.
- **Empty available-transitions list.** Ticket is read-only/merged/closed (`TicketIsReadOnlyException.php`, `TicketConversationReadOnlyException.php`, `TicketAlreadyMergedException.php`). The status control is disabled with a reason, and the composer is hidden or disabled — enforced in `TicketStatusControl.tsx` and `TicketComposer.tsx`.
- **Concurrent assignment.** Two agents claim the same ticket; the loser gets a 409 (`TicketAlreadyClaimedException.php`, `TicketAlreadyAssignedToUserException.php`). `ConflictBanner.tsx` shows the server message and reloads on request. Enforced in `useTicketMutation.ts`.
- **Stale edit after another agent's update.** Version guard rejects (`TicketVersionGuard.php`, `TicketVersionConflictException.php`). Same banner path; the draft is preserved.
- **Attachment infected or still scanning at send time.** The message send is blocked client-side and, if attempted, rejected server-side (`AttachmentInfectedException.php`, `AttachmentPendingScanException.php`). `AttachmentUploader.tsx` renders the state; the composer's submit is disabled while any attachment is not clean.
- **Attachment over the size limit.** Server rejects with the too-large error (`AttachmentTooLargeException.php`); the uploader shows the server message and keeps the rest of the batch.
- **Mention on a public reply.** Backend rejects with `MentionNotAllowedOnPublicReplyException.php` / `MentionTargetNotVisibleException.php`. Surface the field error next to the composer input, do not clear the draft.
- **Unicode / RTL content in subjects, customer names and references.** Arabic text must render correctly in the table (no truncation mid-grapheme, correct bidi isolation for the reference number next to Arabic subject text). Verified against `frontend/src/i18n/ar.json` and `app/Domains/Customers/Services/ArabicTextNormaliser.php` semantics.
- **Empty result sets.** Filtered list with no matches renders `EmptyState` with a "clear filters" action — not a blank table.
- **Forbidden ticket.** Detail fetch returns 403 → `ForbiddenState`; 404 → `NotFoundState`. Both from `frontend/src/shell/states/`.
- **Slow list on a realistic dataset.** Debounce search, keep previous data on page change, request only the needed page size, and never fetch all pages to compute counts. Budget defined in `docs/api/performance-budget.md`; the backend seeder for realistic volume is `database/seeders/PerformanceDatasetSeeder.php`.
- **Session expiry mid-edit.** A 401 during a mutation must route through the existing auth handling in `frontend/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx` / `frontend/src/api/http/errors.ts`; the draft is lost only after the user re-authenticates — do not silently discard it before that.
- **Double-submit of a reply.** Prevented by the idempotency key plus a disabled submit while in flight; backend behaviour is pinned by `tests/Feature/Ticketing/TicketMessageIdempotencyTest.php`.

## Test Plan

Frontend tests use vitest (`frontend/vitest.config.ts`, setup at `frontend/src/test/setup.ts`). Match the style of the existing tests in `frontend/src/api/http/__tests__/envelope.test.ts` and `frontend/src/auth/__tests__/permissions.test.ts`.

1. **Unit — `frontend/src/features/tickets/list/__tests__/useTicketListQuery.test.ts`** — filter/sort/page state serializes to the parameter names in `getTicketsParams.ts`; state round-trips through URL search params; changing a filter resets `page` to 1.
2. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/__tests__/TicketComposer.test.tsx`** — (a) submit is disabled until a visibility mode is chosen; (b) selecting internal mode renders the internal warning badge and submits the internal visibility value; (c) public mode submits the public value; (d) a rejected submit preserves the draft text. **This is the acceptance test for "impossible to send an internal note to a customer by accident."**
3. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/__tests__/TicketStatusControl.test.tsx`** — options render exactly the server-provided available transitions; a status absent from that list is never rendered; an empty list disables the control; a reason-required transition opens the reason dialog and blocks submit until filled.
4. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/__tests__/ConflictBanner.test.tsx`** — a mocked 409 renders the banner with the server message; **Reload latest** triggers a refetch and clears the banner; no silent success is reported.
5. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/__tests__/TicketSlaPanel.test.tsx`** — given a fixed SLA payload, the rendered figures equal the payload values; changing the system clock in the test does not change the rendered remaining/target values.
6. **Guard test — `frontend/src/__tests__/no-sla-recalculation.test.ts`** — static scan of `frontend/src/features/tickets/` for date arithmetic (`Date.now() -`, `getTime() -`, `differenceIn`, `dayjs().diff`) and fail on any hit. Model it on the existing static guard `frontend/src/__tests__/no-role-names.test.ts`.
7. **Guard test — extend `frontend/src/__tests__/no-role-names.test.ts`'s pattern into `frontend/src/__tests__/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** (or extend the existing file if it already covers this) — no literal user-facing strings in the new `frontend/src/features/tickets/` components; all copy resolves through `frontend/src/i18n/`.
8. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/detail/__tests__/AttachmentUploader.test.tsx`** — progress events update the bar; a pending scan state blocks attaching; infected and too-large responses render the server error message.
9. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/list/__tests__/TicketBulkActions.test.tsx`** — selection is page-scoped; partial failure reports each failed ticket with its error message; the list query is invalidated once.
10. **Component — `frontend/src/features/tickets/list/__tests__/TicketListTable.test.tsx`** — empty result renders `EmptyState` with a clear-filters action; 403 renders `ForbiddenState`; sorting emits an encoded sort param and does not reorder rows locally.
11. **No backend test changes.** Confirm the existing suites still pass unchanged, especially `tests/Feature/Api/ContractFreezeTest.php` and `tests/Feature/Api/OpenApiCoverageTest.php` — if either breaks, the frontend touched something it should not have.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend type-check and lint:** in `frontend/` run `npm run lint` and `npx tsc --noEmit` (config: `frontend/tsconfig.json`, `frontend/eslint.config.js`).
2. **Frontend tests:** in `frontend/` run `npm run test` (vitest). All tests in the Test Plan pass.
3. **Frontend build:** in `frontend/` run `npm run build` — no type errors, no unresolved imports from `frontend/src/api/generated/`.
4. **Generated client unchanged:** in `frontend/` run the orval generation command from `frontend/package.json` and confirm `git status` shows **no** diff under `frontend/src/api/generated/`. A diff means the contract was touched — stop and investigate.
5. **Frontend runs:** in `frontend/` run `npm run dev`, log in as an agent, and walk: list → filter → sort → page → save a view → apply it → bulk-assign two tickets → open a ticket → post an internal note → post a public reply → change status → assign → upload an attachment.
6. **Backend regression:** at the repo root run `php artisan test` (see `Makefile` for the project's canonical target) — the backend suite must be untouched and green.
7. **Static analysis:** at the repo root run `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` (config `phpstan.neon`) if any PHP file changed; expected to be a no-op for this story.
8. **Realistic-dataset check:** seed with `php artisan db:seed --class=Database\\Seeders\\PerformanceDatasetSeeder` and confirm the list stays interactive (typing in search does not lock the UI; page changes do not blank the table) against `docs/api/performance-budget.md`.
9. **RTL check:** switch the locale to Arabic in the running app and re-walk step 5. Table and detail panels mirror correctly; no horizontal overflow; the composer's internal-note styling is still unmistakable in RTL.

- [x] `/tickets` renders a server-driven list with filters, sort, pagination and saved views; list state is reflected in the URL and survives reload.
- [x] Bulk actions operate on a page-scoped selection, report per-ticket outcomes including failures, and invalidate the list once.
- [x] `/tickets/:ticketId` shows conversation, properties, customer context, SLA and history **on one screen** with no secondary navigation.

- [x] Every 409 / version conflict renders `ConflictBanner` with the server message and a working **Reload latest** recovery path; drafts are preserved.

- [x] Every async region uses `AsyncBoundary` with the shared `Loading`/`Error`/`Empty`/`Forbidden`/`NotFound` states.
- [x] `frontend/src/api/generated/` has no manual edits and no diff after regeneration.
- [x] Backend suite and `ContractFreezeTest` pass unchanged.
- [x] The bulk-endpoint and saved-view branches taken (server-backed vs. client-side fallback) are stated explicitly in the PR description.
